WITH matched_signals_telescopes AS (
  SELECT s.signalregistry, s.pulsepersec, t.equipstatus
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    equipstatus,
    AVG(pulsepersec) as status_avg
  FROM matched_signals_telescopes
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipstatus
),
overall_avg1 AS (
  SELECT AVG(status_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM status_averages
),
filter1 AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.equipstatus,
    sa.status_avg,
    (sa.status_avg - oa.overall_avg) as diff1
  FROM status_averages sa
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg1 oa
  WHERE sa.status_avg > oa.overall_avg
),
overall_avg2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(status_avg) as overall_avg2
  FROM filter1
),
filter2 AS (
  SELECT 
    f1.equipstatus,
    f1.status_avg,
    f1.diff1,
    (f1.status_avg - oa2.overall_avg2) as diff2
  FROM filter1 f1
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg2 oa2
  WHERE f1.status_avg > oa2.overall_avg2
)
SELECT 
  AVG(status_avg) as avg_status_averages,
  AVG(diff1) as avg_diff1,
  AVG(diff2) as avg_diff2
FROM filter2
